newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria seen cancelling soft wheat tender - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria seen cancelling soft wheat tender - trade.

text.p: Algeria is expected to cancel a tender for the purchase of 75,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat for September, mostly because of firmer world prices, European grain traders said on Wednesday.
"Nothing has been confirmed yet, but the tender may be cancelled or delayed," one exporter said.
"Apparently they could not get the levels they were seeking, so they may have passed," another exporter said.
Algeria was said to be seeking soft wheat at around $160 per tonne, cost and freight, one trader said.
Last Friday Algeria tendered for 75,000 tonnes of soft wheat and for 150,000 tonnes of durum wheat.
There was no official word on the outcome of the durum tender but several exporters said Algeria may have bought part or the entire durum tonnage from Syria.
Algeria was initially seeking durum for shipment in August and September from the United States, Canada or Syria.
